authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full ambara section 1 explicitly records Prakrit ambara sky and Sinhala ambura open air/sky, distinct from the clothing sense in section 2. The selected regional ambar forms preserve this lexical shape and sky meaning, with vowel variation and retroflex final r in Gojri retained. Learned or cross-IA transmission is qualified. Exact response: əmbər.
